description: Changes the persona of one AI assistant, named by id. Only the fields sent change; a list (links, never_say) is the whole new list. The fields are typed (business_name, what_you_do, tone, may_quote_prices, links, never_say, confidence_threshold): there is no free-text prompt. It changes only on a confirmed call: without confirmation_token it changes nothing and returns a preview and a token for a person to approve; called again with that token, it saves. When the assistant is switched on, customers meet the new persona at their next message. Owners and admins.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

id.description: The id in the resource path.

name: update_assistant_persona
title: Change the AI assistant’s persona
